configuration.status: exploratory on already examined dates and current-survivor universe
configuration.fixed_strategy: expanded200, 120-session SPY_PCA3, raw next-bar open to close, unit gross, flat nightly, pre-fee
configuration.reference_stocks: freeze names with 272 complete prior returns at first formation; no later additions or future-completeness filter
configuration.decision_time: after anchor close t; feature histories end t-1; trailing strategy outcomes and completed training labels may end t
configuration.forecast_target: mean gross bps/day of next twenty actual daily strategy trades, not twenty-day frozen initial positions
configuration.latest_partial_targets: predict and trade available days without scoring incomplete twenty-session labels
configuration.history_object: fit SPY residuals on fixed reference stocks; standardize each stock, retain top three residual PCs
configuration.lag_object: 119 points (whitened factor scores at s, scores at s-1)/sqrt(2), six coordinates
configuration.stock_object: fixed reference-stock points in top-three eigenvalue-weighted correlation loading coordinates
configuration.scaling: each cloud's pair distances divided by its own positive median; both raw median distances included in all simple models
configuration.persistence: complete Vietoris-Rips H0/H1 with ripser; infinite H0 excluded from finite summaries, separately counted
configuration.training: expanding prior anchors only; training target end <= decision date; no own/future label; no validation-selected settings
configuration.ridge: unpenalized intercept; training-only mean/std; objective average squared bps error + 1*sum(beta^2); fixed lambda=1, equivalent sklearn alpha=n
configuration.gate_rule: predicted next20 daily mean > 0 => unit-gross original daily strategy for next five sessions, else flat
configuration.calendar: all eligible post-warmup trading days, flat days recorded as zero; five-session allocations do not overlap
configuration.mean_baseline: HistoryMean uses completed historical target mean; AlwaysOn supplies raw strategy and shares its forecast diagnostic with HistoryMean
configuration.period_split: entry before 2024-01-01 development, otherwise later; forecast labels crossing boundary excluded only from period forecast scoring
configuration.online_later_training: completed later labels enter expanding training as time passes; not a fixed 2023-trained model or untouched holdout
configuration.uncertainty: 1000 circular block resamples, 60 daily executions for P&L and 12 five-session forecast anchors for loss; conditional on saved causal forecasts, not a model-refit bootstrap
configuration.primary_comparisons: each PD augmentation minus Simple, paired; approximate simultaneous 95% bands across two augmentations per period, separately for forecast loss and gate mean
configuration.secondary: all model metrics, sign calibration, active fraction, and pointwise intervals; no winning state, threshold or feature selected
configuration.controls: first prior-history window only: common row shuffle, time reversal, uniform return scaling; target outcomes not involved
